events.gpxStatus: Major update: official UTMB pages now show all five 2027 race distances and dates; individual 80K and other race pages expose Map + GPX panels. The previous audit found stale links to 2024-2026 files; do not assume a panel proves the binary is now current. No binary was downloaded/parsed in this pass. The 50K value remains 2,600 hm (not the old app value 2,800).
events.followUp: Inspect actual file endpoints behind all five 2027 Map + GPX panels; confirm year/version in each downloaded file before replacing any old links.

events.name: Austria Backyard Ultra
events.gpxStatus: Organizer pages for Frankenmarkt and Kirchdorf remain the authoritative route sources. Frankenmarkt page advertises a GPX download but the direct file URL was not extracted; Kirchdorf links to Garmin Connect course 245916329 and the loop is stated as 9 hm. No GPX binary downloaded/parsed in this pass; the same Kirchdorf loop link is used for the 7+1 format.
events.followUp: Extract and validate Frankenmarkt organizer GPX; inspect the Garmin course for current-year applicability and avoid duplicating the loop as a different track for 7+1.

events.followUp: Keep event inactive/historical unless organizer announces a new edition; preserve the 2022 GPX for historical reference.
